name: Tarak v1.0.6 — Real Multi-Container Engine, Hardware Telemetry & Mesh Suite
highlights: Real Multi-Container Pods & Init Container execution with process isolation and dedicated logging
Native OCI layer extraction & direct binary execution (Docker, Podman, Windows HCS, or TCR Native sandbox)
Real hardware telemetry sampling: physical RAM and CPU utilization from kernel (GlobalMemoryStatusEx, GetSystemTimes, /proc/stat)
Interactive Web Terminal & Live Container Logs with multi-container selection and WebSocket streaming
Full Service Mesh Suite: Tenant management, mTLS Traffic Permissions, Egress Passthrough, and Canary Traffic Routes
CustomResourceDefinition (CRD) Explorer and Built-in API Resources Catalog in dashboard UI
Multi-platform production binaries compiled for Windows, Linux, and macOS (AMD64 & ARM64)

name: Tarak v1.0.5 — Zero-Trust Security Policies & Ingress Gateways
highlights: TarakSecurityPolicy (TSP) custom resource definition with mTLS strict enforcement
Cloudflare Tunnels and Tailscale private mesh automatic dynamic provisioning
MetalLB layer-2 virtual IP address pool announcer for bare-metal LoadBalancers
Next.js 16 dashboard UI with 39+ management views and responsive glassmorphism

name: Tarak v1.0.4 — StatefulSets, DaemonSets & Persistent Storage Primitives
highlights: Added StatefulSets controller with ordinal pod lifecycle management
Added DaemonSets controller for node-level agents and log collectors
PersistentVolume (PV) and PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) local directory & hostpath storage provider
RBAC authorization matrix with ClusterRoles, RoleBindings, and ServiceAccount PKI

name: Tarak v1.0.3 — Automated Network Routing & Ingress Controller
highlights: Built-in HTTP/HTTPS Ingress Controller with automatic TLS SNI routing
NetworkPolicy enforcement with CIDR and pod selector ingress/egress rules
ConfigMap and Secret injection via environment variables and volume mounts
Diagnostic Event recorder for pod lifecycles, healthchecks, and node heartbeats

name: Tarak v1.0.2 — Multi-Node Clustering Primitives & Worker Join Tokens
highlights: Added worker node discovery and join mechanism with secure cluster join tokens
Heartbeat liveness monitoring and automatic workload rescheduling on node failure
Batch workloads: Kubernetes-compatible Job and CronJob controllers
Client SDK for Go (pkg/client) with REST API helpers

name: Tarak v1.0.1 — Multi-Node Clustering & Public Go SDK
highlights: Added multi-node clustering: separate Control Plane (tarakd) and Worker Node (taraks) daemons
Released public Go client SDK (pkg/client) and runtime primitives (pkg/tcr)
Published complete documentation portal with live changelog at tarak.vikshro.in
Native OCI layer extraction and zero-WSL container isolation on Windows, Linux, and macOS

name: Tarak v1.0.0 — Initial Production Release
highlights: Built-from-scratch zero-dependency container orchestration engine
Kubernetes API compliance with standard Core v1 and Apps v1 resources
Sub-25 MB idle RAM footprint and sub-180ms instant cold-start time
Integrated Virtual Pod Bridge networking with ClusterIP and MetalLB support
Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication with built-in P-256 ECDSA Certificate Authority
